title: R3 delivery carrier beam - initial event notice

sections.heading: Event
sections.text: At 13:24 on 14 October 2024 the R3 delivery carrier beam fell into the mill pit and struck the sled and scaffold platform. No person was struck. The assembly had been parked raised after backup-roll removal during the outage.

sections.heading: Initial observations
sections.text: The keeper plate was found bolted to the recovered assembly. The beam and yoke were not reported fractured. These are initial condition observations, not a conclusion about the release mechanism.

sections.heading: Available leads
sections.text: A motion record, work package, isolation records, inspection photographs and hydraulic records have been retained. Their coverage and applicability must be checked. The cause of the event is not stated in this notice.
